Privacy Policy

How Bill Price, PA handles information collected through this website.

Last updated: August 18, 2026

Who we are

This website is operated by Bill Price, PA, doing business as The Price Law Firm, located at 2633 W. 23rd St., Panama City, FL 32405. You can reach us at 850-215-2195 or bill@thepricelawfirm.com.

Information we collect

Information you give us

When you submit a contact form or the message widget on this site, we collect the information you choose to provide — typically your name, phone number, email address, and a description of your situation. We use it solely to respond to your inquiry and to evaluate whether we may be able to assist you.

Please note: submitting a form does not create an attorney-client relationship, and information you send before such a relationship exists may not be confidential. See our Disclaimer.

Information collected automatically

Like most websites, this site collects limited technical information automatically through analytics, including your IP address, browser type and version, device type, the pages you visit, the time and duration of your visit, and the referring website. This is used in aggregate to understand how the site is used and to improve it.

This site uses Google Analytics 4. Google may set cookies or similar identifiers in your browser. Information about Google's practices is available in Google's own privacy documentation, and you can opt out of Google Analytics using Google's browser add-on.

Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored by your browser. This site uses them for analytics as described above. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or delete existing ones through their settings. Blocking cookies will not prevent you from using this site.

How we use your information

  • To respond to inquiries and consultation requests
  • To evaluate potential representation and check for conflicts of interest
  • To provide legal services to clients who retain the firm
  • To understand site usage and improve the website
  • To comply with legal, regulatory and professional obligations

We do not sell your information

Bill Price, PA does not sell, rent, or trade personal information collected through this website to third parties for their marketing purposes.

We may share information with service providers who help operate the site and the firm — such as website hosting, email, analytics, and case management providers — who are permitted to use it only to provide those services. We may also disclose information where required by law, court order, or the rules governing the practice of law, or where necessary to protect the firm's legal rights.

Confidentiality of client information

Information belonging to clients of the firm is separately protected by the attorney-client privilege and by the confidentiality obligations imposed on attorneys under the Rules Regulating The Florida Bar. Those obligations are broader than this policy, and nothing here limits them.

Data retention

We retain inquiry information for as long as necessary to respond and to meet the firm's professional and legal record-keeping obligations.

Security

We take reasonable measures to protect information submitted through this site. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please do not transmit sensitive or confidential information through this website.

Children's privacy

This website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided information through this site, please contact us so it can be removed.

Your choices

You may contact us at any time to ask what information we hold about you, to request correction or deletion, or to ask that we stop contacting you. Requests can be sent to bill@thepricelawfirm.com or made by phone at 850-215-2195. Some information may need to be retained where the firm has a legal or professional obligation to keep it.

Third-party links

This site links to third-party services, including Google Maps and the firm's Facebook page. Those services have their own privacy policies, and this policy does not apply to them.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised "last updated" date.
